hero.h1: websites for hotels and vacation rentals that convert into direct bookings.
hero.lead: Your guests find you through platforms — and you pay for every single booking. We build the presence that turns searchers into direct bookings: fast, multilingual, connected to your booking system, with imagery that shows your property the way it actually feels.
hero.meta: Boutique hotels · Vacation rentals · Villas & chalets · Serviced apartments

starting.h2: visible on the platforms. invisible as a brand.
starting.intro: Booking.com and Airbnb deliver occupancy — but they don't deliver guest loyalty. The relationship belongs to the platform, the data belongs to the platform, and the price comparison happens right next to your listing. Your own website doesn't solve that by existing. It solves it by being better: faster to load, clearer to navigate, and more trustworthy than the platform your guest just came from.
starting.p1_text: Every platform booking costs margin that's missing from your interiors, your staff and your guest experience.
starting.p2_text: Without your own booking flow there's no email address, no returning guest and no second season.
starting.p3_text: Inside a platform grid every property looks the same. What makes yours special becomes a line of body copy.
starting.p4_text: Slow website-builder pages lose against platforms that are technically optimised without compromise.

services.intro: Not a standard package — the building blocks that actually decide bookings in hospitality.
services.s1_text: A booking flow that leaves no question open: availability, price, what's included and cancellation terms exactly where guests expect them. We make the path from first curiosity to confirmation as short as possible — without losing the calm a good property radiates.
services.s2_text: We connect the system you already use instead of pushing a new one on you. Availability and rates stay in sync with the platforms, double bookings are ruled out, and your team keeps working in the interface it knows.
services.s3_text: Spaces sell through atmosphere. We develop the visual identity, bring your image material into a consistent order and give your property a signature that also holds up beyond the booking page — on social, in newsletters, in the signage on site.
services.s4_text: Guests book in their own language. We implement multilingual setups properly: dedicated URLs per language, clean hreflang markup, localised formats for dates, prices and addresses. No machine translation that costs you trust.
services.s5_text: We structure your site so search engines understand location, amenities, price range and ratings. Plus landing pages for the searches guests actually use to find your region — not the ones that look good in a keyword tool.
services.s6_text: Large images and fast load times are not a contradiction when the architecture is right. We build on modern frameworks, serve content close to the guest and hand you a CMS where you can maintain rates, copy and galleries yourself.

faq.q1: Is a custom website worth it if I'm fully booked on Airbnb and Booking.com?
faq.a1: Especially then. High occupancy via platforms means demand exists — you're just paying for every single booking. Your own booking engine shifts part of that existing demand into a commission-free channel and gives you direct guest relationships. It doesn't replace platforms, it complements them.
faq.q2: Can you connect my existing booking engine?
faq.a2: Usually yes. We work with common booking engines and channel managers, integrating them via APIs or embedded booking flows. If you don't use a system yet, we recommend one that fits your operation's size — rather than our invoice's size.
faq.q3: Do availability and rates stay in sync?
faq.a3: Yes. Your booking engine or channel manager remains the master source; the website displays its live data. This eliminates double bookings while keeping rate management in one place.
faq.q4: Can I edit copy, rates and images myself?
faq.a4: Yes. We implement a Headless CMS that allows you to manage content, galleries and seasonal rates without technical knowledge. Handover includes a walkthrough so your team can work independently.
faq.a5: As many as you can genuinely maintain. Two cleanly translated languages look far more professional than five machine-translated ones. Technically, each language receives its own URL with proper hreflang markup so Google serves the right version.
faq.q6: How do I get found in Google for my local area?
faq.a6: Through three levers: a fast, technically clean website, content targeting what your guests actually search for (location, travel, seasons, occasions), and structured data that makes amenities, price ranges and reviews machine-readable. A fully managed Google Business Profile also plays a key role.
faq.a7: That depends on scope: a single property is built much faster than a portfolio with multiple units and language versions. After the intro call, you'll receive a clear project schedule with fixed milestones.
faq.q8: Do you also cover legal requirements for short-term rentals?
faq.a8: We build the technical foundation: GDPR-compliant forms and analytics, cookie controls, proper pricing and service information, as well as fields for registration or permit numbers required in many regions for short-term rentals. The legal review of actual content remains with you or your legal counsel — we do not provide legal advice.

cta.text: We'll look at where you stand and tell you honestly what's worth doing — and what isn't. Free and without obligation.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Are direct bookings really that much cheaper than OTAs?
faq.a1: Yes, payment processing and booking engine combined typically cost 2–4%, while platforms charge 15–25% commission.
faq.q2: Can a custom website replace OTAs entirely?
faq.a2: Usually not, and that is not the goal. OTAs provide visibility for new guests. Your website converts returning guests and direct inquiries without commission.
faq.q3: How are packages and payback periods calculated?
faq.a3: We compare estimated annual net savings against our benchmark prices for professional website projects with booking integration.
faq.q4: Where do I find my exact commission rate?
faq.a4: Check your contract or extranet terms with each respective platform.
